description: Physics-assisted deep fusion with equal Huber/MSE branches and fruit-median aggregation
optimizer: AdamW; recreated when backbone unfreezes at epoch 6
seed_protocol: once per loss branch; continuous RNG across sequential folds

segmentation.mask_source: full-coverage predicted masks; ground-truth masks are never substituted

prediction_aggregation: horizontal-flip TTA for both branches -> equal Huber/MSE average -> within-fruit median

evaluation.split_method: fixed target-stratified constrained allocation of complete fruit groups
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: validation RMSE improves by >1e-6, or math.isclose RMSE with higher R2; starts at epoch 1; validation used for checkpoint selection
evaluation.primary_weighting: pooled image-weighted out-of-fold R2 after fruit median broadcast
